items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Rene was still with me then. He was with the band eight years.

ctx.x: Rene was still with you then?

Yeah, Rene was still with me then. He was with the band eight years. We played several dates for Burns and all at once it just stopped, but he didn't leave me out entirely, he told me he didn't have anything so you better go on back. So anyway, I went on back and I got a call from Burns again maybe a month or two later and he was sending me in a different direction this time. I don't know if you've ever been on one, but this is really--took the cake--I don't think I did two dates this time, but all at once he…

We played that engagement and I was---we had car trouble, and I mean serious, bearings or something and no money and this and that and it was in the wintertime. I was waiting to hear from Burns and I didn't hear anything so I said to the men, well I'll tell you what, whether he has dates or whatever he has, I said we're going to pile up some kind of way in this car and hook the trailer on this. I think it was the car that was pulling the trailer that broke down. I said we'll come back later and make some…
